prompt.alinti: A developer just released an extension that will now earn you money while AI is thinking. Because when you get AI to do something, you spend quite a lot of time waiting there. I mean you just stare at a meaningless thinking text. And this extension turns that into a source of income by placing ads exactly in that thinking area. So a small ad appears under that thinking line and you get a percentage of the revenue from it. And this is a tool that can be tried in a completely passive and free way. Of course you shouldn't expect anything massive from this, but I wanted to share it with you as an interesting experiment. If you want to try this out today, I'll share the Agent S link in the comments.

yontem.ne: AI bekleme süresini reklamla kazançlı hale getiren VS Code eklentisi.
yontem.alinti: We turned 'Discombobulating' into an ad marketplace. 50% of the revenue goes to you.

akis.ne: Kullanıcı ekranda Kickbacks.ai eklentisini kurar ve Google ile oturum açar.
akis.alinti: 1.Install from the VS Code marketplace (search Kickbacks). 2.Click Kickbacks: Sign in in the status bar. 3.Authenticate with Google. 4.Start using Claude Code. Earnings begin automatically.

akis.ne: AI düşünme süresinde reklamlar otomatik olarak gösterilir ve kullanıcıdan tıklama/imleç hareketi ile kazanç elde edilir.
akis.alinti: A small ad appears under that thinking line and you get a percentage of the revenue from it. Earn passively—impressions and clicks accrue while Claude Code or Codex works. Clicks earn 50x an impression.

akis.ne: Kullanıcının kazancı VS Code status barında gerçek zamanlı olarak gösterilir.
akis.alinti: Your balance shows in the VS Code status bar and updates in real time.

akis.ne: Eklenti kullanıcı kodunu, prompt'ları veya tamamlamaları okumaz ve tamamen geri dönüşümlüdür.
akis.alinti: Zero interference—never reads your code, prompts, or completions. Fully reversible—one click restores Claude Code to its original state.

yazi: VS Code marketplace, Claude Code, Codex, Google oturum açma, 50% kazanç payı, reklam tıklamaları, status bar kazanç gösterimi, ucretsiz, auto-updates, 14,610 installs, $46.54m gelir, 108 tokens, 'Reticulating...' animasyonu, 'Thoughtforls' gibi ekran metinleri.
